decision.observation: At 6:10 p.m., the farmer stands at a clear north–south cobblestone path and east–west road junction; the southern path remains open.
decision.hypothesis: Continuing south along this path should lead out of Pelican Town toward the southeast beach, where Willy may still be outside after shop hours.
decision.memory: The western paved junction's southeast branch reaches the fountain square and then this southern junction. Willy promised an item at the beach; avoid the northern route that ends at the eastern riverbank.
